newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares below 600 lire, suspended.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares below 600 lire, suspended.

text.p: Shares in crisis-ridden Olivetti fell more than 20 percent on the Milan bourse to below 600 lire on Monday, triggering automatic suspension, the stock market council said.
The stock was expected to resume trading at 1600 local time (1400 GMT).
Opening trade in Olivetti shares was delayed for two hours earlier on Monday as pre-bourse price quotes exceeded fluctuation limits set by the stock market council.

The share eventually opened at 619 lire just after 1000 GMT, 17.4 percent down on the last traded price of 749.4 on Wednesday, once the stock market council had widened fluctuation bands to 20 percent from the regular 10 percent.
Olivetti had been suspended by bourse watchdog Consob throughout Thursday and Friday while the authority waited for an Olivetti statement clarifying its half year accounts.
